title: Neon Pong
description: Retro pong bathed in neon light. Fast-paced rallies, power-ups, and a pulsating arcade grid. First to 7 wins.
detailedDescription: Classic pong reimagined through a cyberpunk neon lens. The playfield pulses with animated grid lines and the ball leaves a luminous trail as it accelerates with each rally. Two local players face off in a best-of-13 match, with randomized power-ups — speed boost, wide paddle, multi-ball, and shield — dropping into play at critical moments. The neon aesthetic shifts color palettes between rounds, keeping every match visually fresh.
controls: Player 1: W/S keys to move paddle. Player 2: Arrow Up/Down to move paddle. First to 7 points wins. Pick up glowing power-ups as they appear on the playfield for temporary advantages.
